description: Update a task. Pass dart_id and any fields to change at the top level. Supports add_to/remove_from for incremental relationship changes and optional comment. Relationship arrays use full replacement unless using add_to/remove_from. Relationship fields accept industry-standard names (parent, subtasks, blocked_by, blocks, duplicates, related) — the legacy _ids-suffixed names are deprecated and removed in 0.13.0. Setting any relationship auto-mirrors the inverse side on the related task; mirror_applied / mirror_warnings appear in the response.

add_to.description: Append IDs to relationship arrays. Fetches current values, merges, deduplicates. Keys: subtask_ids, blocker_ids, blocking_ids, duplicate_ids, related_ids

assignees.description: Array of assignee dart_ids, names, or emails

blocked_by.description: dart_ids of tasks blocking this one (canonical name; aliases: blocker_ids, depends_on). Full replacement. Auto-mirrors blocker.blocks.

blocks.description: dart_ids of tasks this one blocks (canonical name; alias: blocking_ids). Full replacement. Auto-mirrors blocked.blocked_by.

comment.description: Optional comment to add after updating (non-blocking)

duplicates.description: dart_ids of duplicate tasks (canonical name; alias: duplicate_ids). Full replacement. Bidirectional mirror.

parent.description: Parent task dart_id (canonical name; alias: parent_task). Auto-mirrors to parent.subtasks.

related.description: dart_ids of related tasks (canonical name; alias: related_ids). Full replacement. Bidirectional mirror.

remove_from.description: Remove IDs from relationship arrays. Fetches current values, filters out specified IDs. Keys: subtask_ids, blocker_ids, blocking_ids, duplicate_ids, related_ids

subtasks.description: dart_ids of child tasks (canonical name; alias: subtask_ids). Full replacement: [] to clear. Auto-mirrors child.parent.

tags.description: Array of tag dart_ids or names

name: update_task
